description: Create a HOSTED, SHAREABLE mock on mockzilla.org from an OpenAPI 3.0+ spec at a public https URL. The server fetches the spec (SSRF-protected) and parses it. Use this when the user gives you a spec URL AND wants a durable, team-visible result — NOT for ephemeral local exploration (use `serve_locally` for that, it accepts the same URL form). The returned sim is in `deploying` state -- follow up with `wait_for_deploy` to receive the live URL.
name: deploy_mock_from_url
